notes: Rechargeable lithium-polymer battery power box with two tip-negative 9 V DC 2.1 mm outputs (up to 1.0 A total), a 3-digit blue LED status display, USB-C charging and a 500 mA courtesy USB output.

jacks.label: 9V DC output
jacks.note: Two tip-negative 2.1 mm output jacks; either one can deliver the unit's 1.0 A capability.

jacks.label: USB-C charge input

jackLayout.note: Connector edges not verified: the official manual figure shows the output/charge connectors but cannot be tied to a physical enclosure edge in the available crop; edges omitted rather than inferred.

power.note: Two single-point-ground 9 V DC outputs; either can deliver the unit's 1.0 A capability. Battery life approx. 2.5 h at 1 A, 5 h at 500 mA, 25 h at 100 mA; charge 2-3 h via USB-C.
Rated 1.0 A output. Included: USB-C charging cable, USB power cube, two 5.5 x 2.1 mm male/male pedal cables, one 8-output daisy-chain cable, Velcro strip and manual.
